text:
renee: opened a PR to fix several console/observability docs breaks in the examples pack. playground panels are empty and a few snippets reference a deprecated trace param. asking for quick reviews because it's blocking a customer demo. :grimacing:

kai: link? saw blanks in the preview earlier.

renee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421 
summary: swap `latency_ms` -> `p50_latency_ms` in dashboard examples, add `p95_latency_ms` as collapsed series; rename tracehook param `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header` in py/go/ts snippets; add short migration note and a troubleshooting bullet for blank panels.

oscar: paste the before/after yaml and a short note about the redirect so infra can prepare.

renee: old yaml snippet:
```yaml
panels:
  - title: \"Latency by route\"
    type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
```
new yaml snippet:
```yaml
panels:
  - title: \"Latency by route\"
    type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
```

renee: python tracehook diff:
```python
# old
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_id_header='x-rw-trace')
# new
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_key_header='x-rw-trace-key')
# compatibility: trace_id_header is still accepted but deprecated
```

mira: nice. UX suggestion: keep p95 collapsed and add a sentence: \"p50 reflects typical latency; p95 surfaces tail latency. Collapse p95 by default to reduce chart noise.\"

kai: I found an external blog link in the guide that returned 410 and caused linkcheck to fail. Replace with internal perf primer or remove.

renee: replaced the 410 link with /docs/perf/primer and added the one-liner Mira suggested. Added a troubleshooting item: \"If dashboards render blank, check the exporter metric names (p50/p95 vs legacy names).\"

infra-bot: infra-ticket created: add a docs scanner to detect legacy metric names matching `*_ms` patterns. Will post findings in #eng-infra next week.

docs-bot: CI: initial linkcheck failed (404 at /console/observability/old-latency-guide). Linter flagged deprecated-field `latency_ms` in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml.

oscar: I'll add a redirect from /console/observability/old-latency-guide -> /console/observability/latency-quantiles once this merges. Please leave a short redirect note in the PR description.

renee: done. PTAL @kai @mira @oscar. Quick reviews welcome.

kai: reviewed, left a tiny nit about YAML quoting. LGTM otherwise.

mira: approved. :+1:

docs-bot: PR merged by renee (docs CI: success)  site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-15 03:30 UTC

oscar: redirect task filed and will be landed after the deploy.

renee: thanks all, closing this thread. Will follow up if the infra scanner finds other legacy metrics.
